about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Entered administration 25 Nov under AlixPartners (600 stores, 11k-12k jobs at risk) after Gordon Brothers failed to agree a solvent sale; stores remain open while in-store refunds ended 26 Nov; Tesco, B&M, Lidl, Iceland and The Range interested.
USTR proposed 15-35% tariffs on 14 trading partners on 25 Nov (China 0-20% or 40% fallback); written comments close 5 Jan 2027, public hearing starts 25 Jan 2027.

Anthropic's Luke Sernau and Claude cut Lean proof 99.5% to 76k compact / 300k readable lines on 25 Nov (Apache 2.0); passed all six Lean checkers at MIT and Waterloo by 26 Nov; full human paper still pending.

threads.topic: Enterprise AI agent protocols and governance
threads.status: Google launched GA Workspace MCP servers, Workspace CLI and Cloud Agent Gateway, mandating MCP/CLI for AI agents from 1 Feb 2027 and Scaled tier billing from 1 Apr 2027.
42 US states and DC moved to block 1 Dec bankruptcy auction of 21m users' private chats (2.1m minors) to Delaware entity Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC.
FIA cut Williams aero testing 1.5% (£627k / 0.48% 2025 cap overspend) and fined Alpine on 25 Nov; Bearman re-signed with Haas on 26 Nov completing 2027 grid; Qatar GP 27-29 Nov.
McLaren enters Qatar GP nine points behind Red Bull for third in Constructors' Championship with 86 points remaining across Lusail and Abu Dhabi.

Eisenkot clinched coalition pact with Liberman (defence, justice, aliyah) and status-quo freeze with UTJ; Knesset advanced PM term-limit bill 65-48; Likud appealed 120 polling stations; mandate expires 6 Dec.
UKMTO reported unknown projectile explosion near tanker 93 km west of Dubai early 26 Nov with no damage; overnight Israeli Gaza strikes killed 8 including Hamas official Khaled Abu Nada.
34 countries and EU at OPCW demanded on 25 Nov that Russia halt battlefield CS/CN teargas use after 14,000 Ukrainian-documented incidents; four-way talks date still pending.

threads.topic: UK winter energy price cap and inflation
threads.status: Ofgem raised Jan-Mar 2027 cap 26% to £2,166 (+£443); BoE Deputy Governor Clare Lombardelli told Treasury Committee on 25 Nov UK food inflation could still hit 5% next year.
389-page Fairfield review (25 Nov) found Met still institutionally racist, misogynistic and homophobic with good progress on 0 of 14 Casey recommendations.

Irish EU presidency proposed 'Made in Europe' car assembly partner status for UK without Chinese EV tariff alignment; EU ministers consider text on 3 Dec; European Partnerships Bill due before Christmas.
Board reinstated Jensen Huang on 23 Nov while federal, state and House inquiries continue; Nvidia and Kioxia demonstrated 1.1 PB SCADA GPU memory expansion on 25-26 Nov.

threads.topic: Anthropic post-IPO and AI safety pacing
threads.status: ANT fell below $83 IPO price to $81.91 on 24 Nov; Axios reported OpenAI/Anthropic staff safety clash alongside Pachocki's 0.68-0.70 log-perplexity ceiling proposal.
